commit_title: Add blocky Dark Neutral-first morphology family (0.25.60)
summary: 0.25.60 adds all nine Dark / Neutral first-evolution adult forms around the unchanged original head and shared rig. The full build and 390 dedicated-server tests passed. One complete 80-scene client run produced 682 original screenshots and a 69.10-second silent motion recording, byte-bound to the delivered JAR. Read the report for actual review scopes and approximations.
limitations: Authored blocky shapes, palettes and interior progression remain first-pass approximations. The original head is unchanged.
Adult alignment and first type stay locked. Opposing current training can recede specialization without reversing maturity.
Actual save coverage is entity NBT/handlers; physical touch, independent remote multiplayer, full restart and every accessory/toy are untested.
Carried face/marker can be obscured by the player; water coverage is stationary. Rabbit head genes and pumpkin intentionally replace the crest.
Distinct reaction faces were not visually activated by case 79; a separate production-emitter visibility regression passed.
The separate journal check retains one inherited failure; the full build/server/focused suites pass.
